firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Akron tear-outs to the studs' 5 words on 3 lines, trade+city+outcome; filled Call primary + quiet underlined 'Price it'; phone in header and hero; status + '4.9 from 98 reviews' with Sample rating chip; drawn wall section (signature) fills the right half; paper rail peeks ~74px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, drawing peeks, mobile bar. Only weakness: the Layer Gauge rail floats at x=15 far from the content column and reads as a pasted widget (-0.5 from 10).

distinctiveness.notes: Layer Gauge / wall-section system shows in hero (1440-first.jpg), pinned story (1440-scroll-25.jpg), service depth bars (1440-scroll-50.jpg), tear-off sheets, pricing ticket layer chips (1440-scroll-75.jpg) and footer row (1440-rm-full.jpg): 9 anchor met. Deductions: the fixed rail does not track the layer on screen (1440-scroll-25.jpg story at Pass 3 Wiring/Plumbing while rail lights 02 Plaster; 1440-scroll-50.jpg services lights 04 Insulation), so it reads as decoration (-0.5). Sibling B (B/qa/screens/1440-first.jpg) also runs split text-left + framed line drawing right, same 'Price it' label; palettes and faces differ, so no full penalty, but the cover-the-logo test is not airtight.

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Bitter display at strong scale against Outfit body, tight tracking, balanced; curly quotes and en-dash hours in dist. Deductions: 1440-scroll-50.jpg shows 4 tiny DM Mono depth captions ('To the subfloor', 'To 07 · Studs'...) plus 3 'Sheet 0N · ...' mono labels in one view (-0.5); middot meta strings repeated (hero kicker, status line, figcaption 'Wall section · drawn to the layer') are a listed tell (-0.5 offset by the strong h1 scale moment).

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: deep hero / paper rail / deep story / paper services grid / signal sheets / paper pricing / deep full-bleed trailer / paper reviews / deep contact / paper footer: tones alternate, dense (services), quiet (trailer), asymmetric (reviews big quote + three small). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: pricing section leaves the left half empty below the heading and the 'Price it' button hangs under the ticket, unanchored (should, not a listed deduction).

photo.notes: No photographs render; imagery is drawn (1440-first.jpg wall section, 1440-scroll-25.jpg framing passes, 1440-scroll-75.jpg trailer + scrap + clean wood) in one consistent drawing language with the palette. Judged on merit as directed: art-directed and on-trade. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: mid-pass the insulation batts sit at ~50% opacity over the studs and the 'DEAD · TAGGED' / 'CAPPED' labels are ghosted to near-invisible, a muddy frame (-0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / dist: concrete trade nouns (zipper seam, ram board, air scrubber, runner on the haul path, mortar bed, joists), honest stop-if-structural line, one primary action name 'Price it' everywhere, Sample labels on rating, reviews, pricing, terms, license; microcopy under the form ('On the real site, Russ K. calls back...'). 0 em dashes. Small repetition: plastic/zipper idea in lead, trust rail 01, story pass 1, sheet 03 and review 1 (not deducted; thesis).

mustFix.problem: Body text #1a1c20 on #b84a1a measures ~3.3:1 at ~18px regular weight; WCAG AA needs 4.5:1
mustFix.fix: Change the signal band background to the safety accent #ff5f1f (ink #1a1c20 on it is ~5.7:1) or set the band's paragraph at >=24px (large-text 3:1) and keep muted text on that tone at the same ink value; re-check the 'Do you work in my ZIP?' strip and any #2e1a0e muted text on the band

elevate.move: Re-tone the sheets band as a designed safety-orange worksite tone (#ff5f1f ground, ink text, deep sheet shadows) so contrast passes by construction and the band reads as hazard tape, not a dim brick block

Bind the Layer Gauge to the layer each section owns (story pass N, services = depth, pricing = selected job's reach, footer = 07 Studs) and drive the rail strike-off and the drawing's layer wipe from the same value, so the rail and the wall peel move as one instrument
